panels.shot: low-angle wide of Khajuraho temple skyline at dawn, with Chhichha's silhouette in foreground
panels.action: Chhichha stands in shadow before the soaring shikhara of the Vishvanatha temple at Khajuraho, dawn light washing the carved towers while distant artisans move like ants along the stone terraces.

dialogue.text: Among Khajuraho’s countless silent stones, one inscription breaks the hush: it names Chhichha, the master builder in whose body, it says, Vishvakarma himself entered.

i18n.hi: खजुराहो के अनगिनत खामोश पत्थरों में, एक लेख ही सन्नाटा तोड़ता है: यह छिछा का नाम लेता है, उस महा शिल्पी का जिसके तन में, लिखा है, खुद विश्वकर्मा ने प्रवेश किया।

panels.shot: aerial bird’s-eye over the Khajuraho complex in morning haze
panels.action: The camera floats above the clustered temples of Khajuraho, their tiered towers rising from the dusty plains, fields and sparse trees surrounding the sacred enclave.

dialogue.text: Around the turn of the first millennium, the Chandelas raised a stone city of gods at Khajuraho, where fields and forests suddenly gave way to a forest of towers.

i18n.hi: पहले सहस्राब्दी के मोड़ पर, चंदेलों ने खजुराहो में देवताओं का पत्थर नगर रच डाला, जहाँ खेत‑जंगल अचानक शिखरों के जंगल में बदल गए।

panels.shot: medium close-up of a weathered stone inscription on the Vishvanatha temple wall
panels.action: A chiseled Sanskrit inscription panel on the Vishvanatha temple wall catches raking light, ancient letters sharp against the smoothed sandstone surface.

dialogue.text: Most hands who built these shrines remain unnamed. Yet on one wall of the Vishvanatha temple, an inscription carefully records a rare name: Chhichha, the sthapati, the master designer-builder.

i18n.hi: इन मंदिरों को गढ़ने वाले ज़्यादातर हाथ बेनाम रहे। फिर भी विश्वनाथ मंदिर की एक दीवार पर, एक लेख सहेजकर लिखता है एक दुर्मिल नाम: छिछा, स्थपति, महा नियोजक‑निर्माता।

panels.shot: slow push-in to Chhichha reading a freshly carved inscription stone
panels.action: In a reimagined moment, Chhichha, middle-aged and steady-eyed, runs his fingers over a freshly carved stone slab lying on a low bench as carvers look on respectfully.

dialogue.text: The inscription, edited by Kielhorn in Epigraphia Indica, says the god of artisans, Vishvakarma, entered Chhichha’s body to raise this house of Shiva. Divine language for a human skill, honed over years.

i18n.hi: एपिग्राफ़िया इंडिका में कीलहॉर्न द्वारा प्रकाशित यह लेख कहता है, शिल्पियों के देवता विश्वकर्मा ने शिव के इस धाम को उठाने को छिछा के तन में प्रवेश किया। दिव्य भाषा, पर मानव कौशल, बरसों की साधना।

panels.shot: top-down shot on ground marked with a vastu grid and tools
panels.action: On packed earth, chalk lines form a precise grid; Chhichha kneels beside it with a cord and measuring rod, surrounded by chisels, plumb bobs, and stone chips.

dialogue.text: Before the first stone was laid, Chhichha’s craft began on the ground—drawing vastu grids, aligning axes, turning cosmological diagrams into a measurable plan.

i18n.hi: पहला पत्थर रखने से पहले ही, छिछा की कला ज़मीन पर शुरू हो चुकी थी—वास्तु ग्रिड बनाना, धुरी मिलाना, ब्रह्मांडीय आरेखों को नाप‑तोले नक्शे में बदलना।

panels.shot: wide shot of quarry and transport line in background, Chhichha overseeing in foreground
panels.action: In a hazy distance, workers cut sandstone blocks from a quarry and haul them on sledges and carts; in the foreground, Chhichha watches, gesturing calmly, supervising the flow of stone.

dialogue.text: Scholars reconstruct the workshop system behind him: quarrying miles away, transporting blocks, rough-shaping them before they reached the rising terraces.

i18n.hi: विद्वान उसके पीछे छुपी कार्यशाला‑व्यवस्था जोड़ते हैं: दूर खदानों से पत्थर निकालना, उन्हें ढोकर लाना, मंज़िल की ओर उठती छतों तक पहुँचने से पहले ही मोटा आकार देना।

panels.shot: medium shot of stone beams being fitted with mortise-and-tenon joints
panels.action: Artisans strain as they slide a carved stone beam into place, its tenon slipping into a mortise cut in the adjacent block, forming a tight, dry joint above a darkened sanctum.

dialogue.text: Without mortar, Khajuraho’s walls and ceilings rely on precise mortise-and-tenon joints. Each beam and bracket had to lock without slack, a discipline of eye and hand.

i18n.hi: बिना गारे के, खजुराहो की दीवारें और छतें नाप‑तौल से जमे खाँचे‑खूँटे पर टिकती हैं। हर कड़ी, हर कंस को ढीलेपन बिना जाम होना था—आँख और हाथ की कड़ी तपस्या।

panels.shot: close-up of a sculptor’s hands carving a high-relief figure
panels.action: A sculptor’s strong hands drive a chisel into sandstone, coaxing a near-free-standing dancer figure from the background, curls of stone dust catching light as they fall.

dialogue.text: High-relief figures, almost freestanding, emerge from the stone faces. Their grace masks the planning beneath, where builders and sculptors coordinated depth, weight and balance.

i18n.hi: पत्थर की सतहों से ऊँचे उभरे, लगभग स्वतंत्र खड़े पुतले निकलते हैं। उनकी लयिली चाल के पीछे छुपा है सारा हिसाब—जहाँ शिल्पी और मूर्तिकार गहराई, भार और संतुलन मिलाकर चलते हैं।

panels.shot: recreation of the Lakshmana Temple sculptor-and-disciples relief as if it were a living scene
panels.action: In a workshop beside the temple, an elder sculptor sits with mallet and chisel amid unfinished figures, while two younger disciples watch closely, tools in hand, echoing the Lakshmana relief.

dialogue.text: On the Lakshmana temple itself, a carved panel shows a sculptor lecturing his pupils. It is a rare self-portrait of the craft: knowledge passed from hand to hand, in stone.

i18n.hi: ख़ुद लक्ष्मण मंदिर पर एक पैनल में एक शिल्पी अपने शिष्यों को समझाता दिखता है। यह कला का दुर्लभ आत्म‑चित्र है: ज्ञान जो हाथ से हाथ में, पत्थर पर उतरता है।

panels.shot: medium shot of Chhichha conferring with artisans on scaffoldings
panels.action: Perched on bamboo scaffolding against the temple’s outer wall, Chhichha discusses a carved niche with two sculptors, pointing to a blank panel and then to a palm-leaf drawing.

dialogue.text: Textual traditions call such a figure the sthapati—the one who combines design, structure and ritual understanding. Kapila Vatsyayan writes of him as both engineer and aesthetic mind.

i18n.hi: शास्त्र ऐसे शिल्पी को स्थपति कहते हैं—जो रूप, ढांचा और विधि, तीनों को जोड़ दे। कपिला वात्स्यायन उसे एक साथ अभियंता और रस‑बुद्धि बताती हैं।

panels.shot: low-angle interior shot from sanctum looking up into the tower under construction
panels.action: From the dark sanctum, the camera looks up through a rising shaft of stone courses and corbelled rings, where Chhichha stands above, outlined against the sky as workers inch blocks into place.

dialogue.text: Inside, corbelled courses of stone climb inward to form the towering shikhara. Each layer had to follow the sacred profile yet remain structurally sound—a problem solved many times, never recorded.

i18n.hi: अंदर, ओढ़े‑चढ़े पत्थरों की परतें भीतर की ओर चढ़ती हैं और ऊँचा शिखर रचती हैं। हर परत को पवित्र आकृति भी निभानी थी, और मज़बूत भी रहना था—अनगिनत बार सुलझी पर कभी लिखी न गई पहेली।

panels.shot: medium close-up on Chhichha’s face, half-lit, as he watches the completed tower
panels.action: Chhichha stands at a distance, face half in shadow, half in sun, eyes lifted toward the completed Vishvanatha shikhara as bells faintly sway in the wind.

dialogue.text: The inscription’s claim that Vishvakarma entered his body belongs to a language of inspiration. It does not tell us his life story, only how his contemporaries saw his role—as a vessel for divine craft.

i18n.hi: लेख का यह कहना कि विश्वकर्मा उसके तन में उतरे, प्रेरणा की भाषा में आता है। यह हमें उसका जीवन नहीं, बस इतना बताता है कि समकालीन उसे कैसे देखते थे—दैवी शिल्प के पात्र की तरह।

panels.shot: wide shot of Khajuraho with multiple temples, Chhichha as a small figure among many artisans
panels.action: On a broad view of Khajuraho’s main cluster, lines of artisans carry tools and blocks across courtyards; Chhichha is just one small figure among them, almost lost in the bustle.

dialogue.text: Scholars like Vidya Dehejia remind us: behind each sthapati stood many shilpins. Khajuraho’s achievement belongs to entire workshops, even if only one master builder is named.

i18n.hi: विद्या देहजिया जैसे विद्वान याद दिलाते हैं: हर स्थपति के पीछे अनगिनत शिल्पी खड़े थे। खजुराहो की विजय पूरे शिल्प‑दल की है, चाहे लेख में बस एक महा शिल्पी का नाम बचा हो।

panels.shot: close-up of anonymous sculpted faces on the temple exterior
panels.action: A tight frame shows a row of finely carved figures—musicians, dancers, attendants—faces individualized yet unknown, their stone eyes gazing out over the centuries.

dialogue.text: No inscription tells us who carved these faces. Their makers vanish into silence, their signatures hidden in the curve of a lip, the tension of a hand on a lute.

i18n.hi: कोई लेख नहीं बताता कि इन चेहरों को किसने تراशा। रचयिता सन्नाटे में खो जाते हैं; उनके हस्ताक्षर बस होंठ की मोड़ में, या वीणा पर तनी उँगली के तनाव में छुपे हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot of the Vishvanatha inscription again, now with weathering and lichen
panels.action: The same inscription panel on the Vishvanatha temple is now seen centuries later, edges softened by time, tiny patches of lichen creeping between the letters.

dialogue.text: Yet that single panel, edited in Epigraphia Indica, anchors a name in time. Chhichha becomes our doorway into a whole system of knowledge that otherwise remains faceless.

i18n.hi: पर वही छोटा‑सा लेख, जो एपिग्राफ़िया इंडिका में छपा, एक नाम को समय में गाड़ देता है। छिछा हमारे लिए उस पूरे ज्ञान‑तंत्र का दरवाज़ा बन जाता है जो वरना बेचेहरा रहता।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide shot of Chhichha’s shadow merging with temple wall at sunset
panels.action: At sunset, Chhichha’s elongated shadow stretches across the base of the temple and blends into the carved stone friezes, as the sky burns orange behind the silhouette of the shikhara.

dialogue.text: In Chhichha’s fleeting name, we glimpse all the unnamed makers of Khajuraho—and are reminded that every great monument is a pact between remembered rulers and forgotten hands.

i18n.hi: छिछा के क्षणभंगुर नाम में हमें खजुराहो के सारे अनाम शिल्पी झलकते हैं—और याद आता है कि हर विराट स्मारक असल में याद रखे राजाओं और भुला दिए हाथों के बीच का एक मौन समझौता है।

subtitle_i18n.hi: जब पत्थर ने अपने निर्माता को याद किया
